title: Skeletons, trace tests, and interface schema

criteria.statement: Every new function and endpoint has a skeleton with a signature, expected input and output shapes, and a docstring or usage spec. Stub bodies return shape-valid data or fail explicitly as not implemented.
Trace tests cover each new boundary with test data, and at least one test is an end-to-end or integration path through every layer the task touches.
A machine-readable interface schema exists at the declared repository path in the target stack's idiom, with short usage notes, and is versioned with the code.
Claimed skeleton names and signatures match the schema file. A later interface change MUST update the schema in the same change.
